mapper.sql: cst.id AS id, cst.crm_support_activity_id AS activityId, csa.name AS activityName, cst.name AS taskName, cst.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, cst.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM crm_support_tasks AS cst INNER JOIN crm_support_activities AS csa ON csa.id = cst.crm_support_activity_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = cst.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = cst.modified_by

WHERE cst.is_active = 1 AND csa.is_active = 1
AND ( cst.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR csa.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE cst.is_active = 1 AND csa.is_active = 1 AND cst.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_support_tasks(crm_support_activity_id, name, created, created_by, is_active) VALUES (#{task.activityId}, #{task.name}, NOW(), #{task.createdBy}, #{task.isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_support_tasks SET crm_support_activity_id = #{task.activityId}, name = #{task.name}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{task.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{task.id} AND is_active = 1
